description: Verified complaint channels for Hyderabad, Telangana. Every record was read from the official page in source_url on verified_on. Fields the source does not state are null. See docs/office_data_sources.md.

records.name: GHMC Head Office
records.address: CC Complex Tank Bund Road, Lower Tank Bund Hyderabad: 500063
records.notes: Address and phone exactly as listed under 'Reach Us' on the official Key Contacts page. Under the Telangana Core Urban Region (Integrated Governance) Act, 2026 the old GHMC area was split into GHMC, Cyberabad (CMC) and Malkajgiri (MMC) municipal corporations; the GHMC Key Contacts page lists zones Shamshabad, Golconda, Secunderabad, Rajendranagar, Charminar and Khairathabad. Check which corporation covers your area. Coordinates geocoded from the OSM 'Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation' townhall feature (PIN 500063).

records.name: GHMC Helpline
records.notes: Listed as 'Helpline:21111111' (no STD code printed; Hyderabad landlines use 040). Operating hours are not stated on the page. Listed on the GHMC page only; not confirmed for the Cyberabad or Malkajgiri corporations.

records.name: Integrated Grievance System (IGS) - Lodge Grievance
records.notes: Linked as 'Grievance > CITIZEN', 'Lodge Grievance' and 'Complaint' on the GHMC home page; the same link appears on the Cyberabad (cmc.telangana.gov.in) and Malkajgiri (mmc.telangana.gov.in) corporation home pages. The portal asks for a mobile number and OTP. Grievance status: https://igs.ghmc.gov.in/operator/search.

records.name: GHMC citizen mobile app
records.notes: The GHMC home page links 'Download My CURE Mobile App' (Google Play, id cgg.gov.ghmc) and 'MyGHMC Citizen' (Apple App Store: https://itunes.apple.com/in/app/myghmc-citizen/id1232220629?mt=8). The page does not say which complaint types the app accepts.

records.name: Cyberabad Municipal Corporation - Lodge Grievance
records.notes: Official CMC website; its 'Lodge Grievance' / 'Complaint' links open the Integrated Grievance System (igs.ghmc.gov.in). The CMC Key Contacts page (https://cmc.telangana.gov.in/KeyContacts.aspx) lists Serilingampally, Kukatpally and Quthbullapur zones. No head-office address was found on the pages checked.

records.name: Malkajgiri Municipal Corporation - Lodge Grievance
records.notes: Official MMC website; its 'Lodge Grievance' / 'Complaint' links open the Integrated Grievance System (igs.ghmc.gov.in). The MMC Key Contacts page (https://mmc.telangana.gov.in/KeyContacts.aspx) lists Malkajgiri, Uppal and L.B. Nagar zones. No head-office address was found on the pages checked.

records.name: HMWSSB Head Office
records.organisation: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (HMWSSB)
records.address: Administrative Office Building, Khairatabad, Hyderabad - 4, Telangana
records.coordinates_source: Google Maps embed on the official HMWSSB website (place 'HMWSSB Building')
records.notes: Address, phone (EPABX, Khairatabad) and email as printed in the Contact Us section. The address gives 'Hyderabad - 4' rather than a six-digit PIN, so pincode is left empty. The email is the Managing Director's office address shown on the contact page.

records.name: HMWSSB 24 Hours Customer Care
records.organisation: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (HMWSSB)
records.notes: Contact page: 'Water supply & sewerage related complaints - Customer Care Center 155313'. Home page header: '24 Hours Customer Care:155 313' and customer-support@hyderabadwater.gov.in.

records.name: HMWSSB Register Grievances
records.organisation: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (HMWSSB)
records.notes: Linked as 'Register Grievances' under Customer Services on the official home page. Status page: https://www.hyderabadwater.gov.in/en/index.php/services/customers-services/grievances-status. Billing disputes have a separate link on the home page.

records.name: HMWSSB Know Your Area Officer
records.organisation: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (HMWSSB)
records.notes: Official lookup page (embeds https://bms.hyderabadwater.gov.in/kyo/knowyourofficer.aspx/) for finding the local HMWSSB officer for an area. Individual officers' details are not copied into this dataset.

records.name: TGSPDCL Corporate Office
records.organisation: Southern Power Distribution Company of Telangana Limited (TGSPDCL)
records.coordinates_source: Google Maps embed on the official TGSPDCL website (contact section)
records.notes: Address and email from the contact section of the official website (the site is a single-page app; details are in its published page bundle). For supply faults the site directs consumers to the 1912 helpline rather than this office.

records.name: TGSPDCL 24x7 Toll-Free Helpline 1912
records.organisation: Southern Power Distribution Company of Telangana Limited (TGSPDCL)
records.notes: Shown on the official site as '24x7 Toll-Free: 1912' / '24x7 Emergency Helpline' for power faults, outages and dangerous situations.

records.name: TGSPDCL No Power Complaint
records.organisation: Southern Power Distribution Company of Telangana Limited (TGSPDCL)
records.notes: Linked as 'No Power Complaint' under Consumer Services on the official site.

records.name: TGPCB Head Office
records.address: A-3, Paryavaran Bhavan, Sanath Nagar Rd, Sanath Nagar Industrial Estate, Sanath Nagar, Hyderabad, Telangana 500018
records.coordinates_source: Google Maps embed on the official TGPCB website (map centre; approximate)
records.notes: Address and 'PBX Number : 040-23887500' from the contact section of the official home page. No email is listed there.

records.name: TGPCB Toll-Free Number

records.name: Janavani - Kalushya Nivarani (Public Grievance)
records.notes: Linked from the official TGPCB home page as 'Janavani Kalushyanivarini (Public Grievance)'. The portal itself is hosted on a non-government domain (glensserver.com); we list it only because the official site links to it.

records.name: HYDRAA Toll-Free Helpline 1070
records.organisation: Hyderabad Disaster Response and Asset Protection Agency (HYDRAA)
records.notes: Official site: 24/7 civic emergency helpline; 'Call the toll-free emergency command desk ... to report civic emergencies, trees down, blockages, or active asset violations.' Jurisdiction stated as the CURE area (GHMC, CMC, MMC). Use for emergencies and violations, not routine maintenance requests.

records.name: HYDRAA Office
records.organisation: Hyderabad Disaster Response and Asset Protection Agency (HYDRAA)
records.address: 7th Floor, Buddha Bhavan, Rani Gunj, Secunderabad - 500003
records.notes: Address from the footer of the official home page. Coordinates left empty: OpenStreetMap Nominatim returned no reliable match for Buddha Bhavan, so no distance is shown. The page does not say whether walk-in complaints are accepted.

records.name: Prajavani grievance portal
records.notes: State public grievance programme. The portal describes in-person Prajavani sessions (state level in Hyderabad on Tuesdays and Fridays; district, division and mandal levels on Mondays) and lets citizens check grievance status and print receipts by mobile or reference number. It does not clearly state that grievances can be filed online.

records.name: Emergency number 112
records.notes: Listed under 'EMERGENCY CONTACTS' on the official Telangana Police website (Police: 112; the same list gives Fire and Rescue 101 and Ambulance 108). Only for emergencies such as danger to life or property.
